channel.title: Groviadigi: blog and AI automation news
channel.description: Business automation, custom CRMs and AI news from Groviadigi.

item.title: From WhatsApp chats to a custom solar CRM: what changed in 3 months
item.description: Smart Sun Power ran sales, surveys, installs and payments across WhatsApp, calls and spreadsheets. We built them a custom solar CRM. Here is what changed in the first three months, and what we would tell anyone thinking about a CRM.

item.title: Citi tells customers they carry the risk if a third-party AI agent misuses their account
item.description: In November 2026, Citi added a section on third-party AI agents to its online banking terms: what an agent does with your login counts as authorised by you. What changed and what it means for small businesses.

item.title: AWS Marketplace now lets AI agents buy software, within budgets and rules a company sets
item.description: On 19 November 2026, AWS added agents to its Marketplace that can research, check and buy software, plus pay-per-request payments for AI agents. Here is what changed and what it means for how businesses buy tools.

item.title: Microsoft adds spending limits for AI agents as company AI bills grow harder to track
item.description: At Ignite on 17 November 2026, Microsoft announced Agent 365 Cost Management, which lets admins set spending limits and alerts for usage-based AI services and agents. Here is what it does and why AI costs deserve a plan.

item.title: How to merge duplicate leads from multiple spreadsheets into one master list
item.description: Lists from Apollo, past campaigns and ad platforms kept overlapping. We built Data Sorter for a cross-border CFO firm: one master list, two checks on every upload, and a usage record per channel.

item.title: AT&T runs nearly 500 AI agent workflows, and every one starts with a human checking it
item.description: AT&T says it now has close to 500 agentic AI workflows in production and plans to triple that next year. The more useful lesson for smaller firms is how it keeps people in charge until the agents prove accurate.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can pay, and tells businesses to stop blocking them
item.description: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents complete purchases with a card token and a biometric check. Alongside it, OpenAI has published guidance on what online businesses need to change to accept those orders.

item.title: How we automated SEO for a finance firm without losing the human review
item.description: Growth Center plans a monthly SEO, AEO and GEO strategy, writes and fact-checks every blog, and still waits for a person before anything goes live. Here is how we built it.

item.title: IBM and Microsoft launch Imagine Enterprise, an AI agent platform with 6,000+ prebuilt agents
item.description: IBM and Microsoft have announced Imagine Enterprise, a platform for building, running and governing AI agents across business processes. Here is what it includes and what it means for smaller companies.

item.title: A social media dashboard that designs, learns and keeps the brand consistent
item.description: How we built a social media dashboard that makes on-brand banners for every blog, learns design from videos the team picks, remembers its mistakes and works with an SEO dashboard.

item.title: Gartner: only 21% of service leaders have cut agent headcount because of AI
item.description: A Gartner survey of 275 service and support leaders finds AI is mostly supporting customer service teams, not replacing them. Here are the numbers and what they mean for your business.

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows is now generally available: AI agents inside GitHub Actions
item.description: GitHub’s Agentic Workflows, which run AI coding agents inside GitHub Actions for tasks like issue triage and documentation, are now generally available on all plans. Here is what changed.
